transcript.text: How can I change notification frequency in the web version?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Morgan. In the web version, open Notifications, choose Frequency, select Daily, and save.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Saved, thank you.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Your frequency setting is saved. Let us know if you need more help. Goodbye.

transcript.text: How do I choose a date range for my report?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Morgan. Open Reports, select Start date and End date, then click Download.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Why do I have to choose both dates?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: They define the beginning and end of the reporting period.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Understood, downloaded.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Your report is downloaded. Goodbye.
